messages:
Maria Chen: quick mock attached — thinking about an inline setup toolbar that sits above the project list when a user has no projects. shows two CTAs: ‘Start a quickstart’ and ‘Add a sample project’. thoughts on copy + a11y/keyboard behavior? https://file.mock/redwood/mock.png Josh Patel: Nice! Inline feels less modal-y and keeps context. Copy thought: prefer ‘Create your first project’ or ‘Try a quickstart’ over ‘Start’ — more actionable. :thumbsup: Lee Wong: Accessibility: ensure the toolbar uses role=\"toolbar\" and has an aria-label, e.g. aria-label=\"Onboarding actions\". Must be in normal tab order (don’t trap). Also ensure visible focus states for each CTA. Example: ```html
``` Samira: From product POV — low decision load for first run. Show 1-line descriptors under sample picks, not full docs. Suggested sample list: - Embeddings playground — small text+search demo - Chat agent starter — assistant + tools - Reranker microservice — pair with evals Also track an event `onboard_quickstart_start` and `onboard_sample_pick` so we can measure lift. Ara (designbot): Design nits: secondary CTA contrast currently ~3.2:1 on mock, needs >=4.5:1 to meet AA for text. Increase saturation or use outline + darker text. Add 3px focus ring for keyboard users. Mobile layout: toolbar should collapse to a single row with icon + label. Will update tokens. Maria Chen: Good catches. Can we A/B test copy: Variant A = ‘Create your first project’, Variant B = ‘Try a quickstart’. 50/50, metric = quickstart click rate and 7-day project retention. @growth any concerns? Josh Patel: Prefer Variant A for clarity. Test plan: 2 weeks or until N=1k unique new users, whichever comes first. Report: CTR, 7-day retention, first-token latency (if they actually run quickstart). Lee Wong: I’ll add aria attributes and keyboard nav notes to the a11y doc and a tiny example in the console docs. Also will ensure screen reader announces when toolbar appears: `role=region` with `aria-live=polite` if needed. Samira: I'll fold sample picks + analytics events into the onboarding PRD and add acceptance criteria: keyboard nav, contrast, analytics firing. Will also draft microcopy variants for each sample project. Ara (designbot): I’ll push updated mocks by EOD — higher contrast buttons, focus states, mobile collapse. Will include exportable tokens and a redlined spec for engineering. Maria Chen: Action items: Josh -> A/B test setup, Lee -> accessibility patch + docs, Ara -> updated mocks, Samira -> PRD + events. I’ll slot this into console sprint board and make a tiny release checklist. Thanks all. :rocket: OnboardBot: Created task ONB-345 — \"Inline onboarding toolbar: copy + accessibility\" (assignees: Josh, Lee, Ara, Samira)
